candidates.change_summary: Replace require(msg.sender == ...) with require(msg.sender == caddress) so that a different caller can invoke transfer.
Delete the sender check require statement so that anyone can call transfer.
Delete the require(_tos.length > 0) check so that an empty array call is allowed.
Delete the overflow/zero-check require for v[i] inside the loop so invalid amounts can be accepted.
Change the multiplier from 1000000000000000000 to 0 so that all transferred amounts become zero.
Replace from with msg.sender in the encoded call data so that the source of the transfer is the caller instead of the hardcoded address.
Replace from with address(this) in the encoded call data so that the contract itself is the source.
Replace caddress with a hardcoded zero address as the target of the call so that all transfers go to a different contract.
Insert `return false;` before the loop so that true is never returned.
Insert `revert();` at the top of the function body so that every call fails.
Replace function visibility from public to external so that the ABI and call patterns change.
